title: Plan for the model failing
text: A failed call falls back to a lighter model, then a different provider, and nothing reaches the user until it clears schema enforcement and a self-critique step. That is how agent failures at Crehana dropped 25%.

title: Authorization, not redaction
text: An answer about someone's own records needs those records. So the control is what the model is handed: retrieval filtered by organization, then by what that user may already open.

title: Score every change against a fixed set
text: Every change to retrieval was scored for answer accuracy on a 200-question golden set before it counted as an improvement.

title: Size the model to the decision
text: The fraud MVP flagged about 9% of transactions, more than any team could review. I rebuilt it to flag the ~2% the client's analysts can act on, in real time, across 35 institutions.
